verdict.rationale: Square documents its own catalog capability (Catalog API, 'Design a Catalog') and inventory capability (Inventory API, 'Track inventory' on the merchant site), so the core of managing items and counts is first-party. The evidence consists only of page titles and taglines, and nothing shows counts staying in sync across registers, locations and online channels. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of cross-register/cross-channel inventory sync, detail beyond page titles, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can manage an item catalog with inventory counts that stay in sync across registers and channels

citations.quote: Square APIs and SDKs for accepting payments, managing catalogs, running storefronts
